format: Version numbers are MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (big redesign . new features . fixes). Every update has a name. Newest first. Bump this file to ship an update.

releases.name: The Customizer Update
notes: Media bar: pulling it up now lifts the bar away from the tab buttons while you resist, and the corners round off as the gap opens
Tab bubble haptics: a buzz when you pick it up, a click on every tab it passes over, and a thud when you let go (portrait and sideways)

releases.name: The Customizer Update
notes: New Customize centre (Settings → Make it yours): reorder or hide the four tabs, pick your start tab, change song row size, album grid size, and what each row shows
Sorting like Musicolet: a sort button on every tab — title, artist, album, year, date added, duration, most played and more, ascending or descending, remembered per tab
Fullscreen player: choose the background (living fog, blurred cover, accent glow or black), visualizer style (bars, mirror, wave, dots), its colour, height and opacity
Choose the cover's shape and size, the lyrics' size, alignment, glow and fade, the play button style and the seek bar thickness, and add lyrics / equalizer / sleep / queue buttons
Sideways Fullscreen is rebuilt: the big album cover on the left, lyrics or the title on the right, controls along the bottom
Lyrics no longer have hard edges: the top, bottom and sides fade softly and the glow and blur are never cut off
The equalizer is live the instant you open Fullscreen — no more delay
When the media bar is tucked into its little square, the player now grows out of it and shrinks back into it
The top glass bar is raised above the screen edge so its rounded top is never seen
Media bar: optionally hide the progress line or the next button; accent colour can follow the cover or stay fixed

releases.name: The Collector Update
notes: Finding covers is much smarter: it asks iTunes, Deezer and MusicBrainz, forgives accents, "(Deluxe)", "- Single", "feat." and messy YouTube-style titles, and scores every answer on how well the title and artist match
If the album can't be found, it looks up the songs themselves; songs with no album get the cover of their own single
Three albums are looked up at once, with progress, and the result says how many were found and how many couldn't be matched
Songs without a cover are found automatically in the background, including the ones that failed before
Hold an album (in Albums, a shelf or search) for its menu: Play, Shuffle, Play Next, Add to Queue, Playlist, Favorite, Go to Artist, Look Up Info, Find Cover, Choose Cover, Share, Remove
Hold an artist for theirs: Play, Shuffle, Radio, Queue, Playlist, Favorite, Get More from YouTube Music, Find Missing Covers
Downloads are faster: three songs at once, each fetched in four pieces at the same time, the cover comes down alongside the audio, and the hidden browser warms up when you open YouTube search

releases.name: The Demo Update
notes: Fixed: the glass behind the tab bar, the media bar and the headers could vanish (leaving only the buttons) after you left the app with Back and opened it again. The glass is now rebuilt every time the screen is created, and fixes itself if it ever goes missing

releases.name: The Demo Update
notes: New: Music Packs can carry synced lyrics. A song's entry in musicpack.json can have a "lyrics" field with LRC text, and it shows up in the lyrics view without needing LRCLIB
Made for the Strata Demo pack: 45 invented songs with invented lyrics for "Open Fields"

releases.name: The Synced Update
notes: New: Settings › Look & Feel › Visual Timing. Move the visualizer and background effects earlier or later (up to half a second either way), with a live visualizer and beat pulse right under the slider so you can see when it lines up with the music
The visualizer and fog follow the audio's real position (speaker or Bluetooth delay included) and update every frame

releases.name: The Sideways Update
notes: The visualizer and the fog background are in time with the music now: they follow what the speaker (or Bluetooth headphones) is actually playing instead of trailing behind
The visualizer updates twice as often, every frame

releases.name: The Sideways Update
notes: Sideways: the tabs become a vertical glass pill on the right, with a round bubble you can drag up and down
Sideways: the media bar is its own glass bubble along the bottom
Sideways: scroll and the media bar tucks away. It wraps down to its album cover and slides in under the tab pill as the pill shrinks to make room, then comes back after the Scroll Timer
Settings and Keep Media Bar Tucked keep it tucked; tap the tucked cover to open the player
Everything slides and resizes smoothly between the shapes

releases.name: The Fog Update
notes: The player's live background is back: two colours from the cover drift as clouds that swell with the bass and flash on big hits
The full-screen visualizer is back behind the player, fading out towards the top
Skipping swings the cover off on a curve: it tilts and shrinks away while the next one swings in
Tap the album cover to turn it over and see the song's info
Lyrics: the current line sits in the middle, the list glides there smoothly, and passed lines dim and blur away above it. Drag to look around; it glides back after a moment
In lyrics, tap the small cover or the title to go back to the album cover
Held buttons keep a circle of liquid glass behind them, even while you drag them about
Switches glide after your finger and snap to a side like iOS
More haptics: opening pages, closing menus, skipping, scrolling through lyrics, switches
The media bar no longer has a visualizer

releases.name: The Lens Update
notes: Tab bubble follows the pages as you swipe between tabs, instead of catching up after
Dragging the tab bubble tracks your finger instantly

releases.name: The Lens Update
notes: Tab bubble: a rounded iOS-style pill that swells while you drag it, magnifying the icons under it (sharp in the middle, split into red, green and blue at the rim)
Switches: drag the handle across; while you hold it, it swells into a liquid glass lens and the track colour follows it
Buttons give a little under your finger, like iOS, and spring back when you let go
Pulling the player down holds on for a moment, with growing buzzes, then lets go with a thud
Page headers are glass: the bar fades in smoothly as you scroll, with rounded bottom corners
Glass tracks the UI in the same frame now: no more jitter while things move
Fixed: slowly swiping the player down could leave it stuck halfway

releases.name: The Gloss Update
notes: Every floating panel is the glass itself now, and it follows its control exactly on every frame (no more glass left behind or in the wrong place)
Glass settings: thickness, bend, colour split, frost, opacity and tilt shine (Settings › Look & Feel › Glass), live while you drag
Tug to open: the whole bar gives a little with a buzz that grows as you pull, then lets go; the media bar jumps to your finger and a glass panel slides up fast from the bottom to meet it
The player stays glass until it's fully open, and its corners ease into shape
Closing (or letting go low) shrinks the player back into the media bar's spot and the tab bar rejoins it — no more sliding away and popping back
Only one set of covers at a time while you open or close the player
Fixed: tapping a tab could stop halfway on the wrong page
Fixed: a stray pane of glass over the equalizer

releases.name: The Glamor Update
notes: Liquid Glass everywhere: the bottom bar, the tab bubble, the tool buttons, menus, messages and the selection bar are real glass (QWEA0's Liquid Glass) that bends the music behind it, splits light at the edges and catches the light as you tilt
New way to open the player: pull the media bar up and it peels off, sticks for a moment, then breaks loose and the player follows your finger up from the bottom
Haptics everywhere, just like before: taps, ticks on sliders and the seek bar, a thud when the bar breaks loose, buzzes for likes, saves and errors
Liquid Glass off gives the classic frosted blur on the same controls

releases.name: The Mirror Update
notes: Looks and works like the original Strata Music: same menus, settings, search and queue
Liquid Glass: the bottom bar bends and splits the light behind it (switch it off for the classic frosted blur)
The media bar grows into the full player, and shrinks back when you drag it down
Swipe the album cover to slide to the next or previous song
Double-tap a song, album or artist to like it
Pop-up menus swipe down to close
Queue: hold and drag to reorder, swipe left to remove
Updates right inside the app: Settings › Updates
If the app ever crashes, the next launch shows what happened with a Copy button
Fixed: tapping a tab two away stopped on the tab in between
Fixed: the app crashed on opening

releases.name: The Native Update
notes: Strata Music rebuilt as a fully native Android app
Your library, playlists, favorites, lyrics and settings carry over from the old app
YouTube Music search and downloads with a browser that only runs while downloading
Synced lyrics, equalizer, crossfade with beat matching, silence cutting
Music Packs, folders, radio and mixes
